steps.clickAt: (() => { const e=[...document.querySelectorAll('*')].find(x=>/^首帧 · #\d+/.test((x.innerText||'').trim()) && x.getBoundingClientRect().x>500 && x.getBoundingClientRect().x<1000 && x.getBoundingClientRect().height<40); const r=e?.closest('button, [role=button], [class*=thumb], [class*=tile], [class*=mini]')?.getBoundingClientRect() || e?.getBoundingClientRect(); return r?[r.x+r.width/2,r.y+Math.min(r.height/2,60)]:[null,null]; })()

(() => { const e=[...document.querySelectorAll('button,[role=tab]')].find(b=>/^版本/.test(b.innerText.trim()) && b.getBoundingClientRect().x>innerWidth*0.7 && b.getBoundingClientRect().y<120); const r=e?.getBoundingClientRect(); return r?[r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2]:[null,null]; })()

(() => { const items=[...document.querySelectorAll('.v3e-ver .v3e-chain [class*=node], .v3e-ver .v3e-chain button')].filter(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().width>0); const e=items[2]||items[items.length-1]; e?.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); const r=e?.getBoundingClientRect(); return r?[r.x+r.width/2,r.y+Math.min(r.height/2,10)]:[null,null]; })()
